$description: A policy of the case's own — the only file of this fixture. `check-package.mjs` reads the policy out of the package when the package carries one, and out of the library otherwise, so a case can put a defective list in front of the gate. A real package never carries this file: nothing in `ng-package.json` copies it, so day to day the road is always the library's.
